scenario_description:
Objective: Keep the June 3 plate-solving clinic usable by satisfying its offline catalog prerequisite before the equipment list is exported.
Emerging Need: Notices first make the catalog rule conditional, then confirm that participants must either have a local install or an assigned club SSD.
Decision Context: The stored laptop-care record is needed to choose between local installation and a reversible loaner hold once the SSD channel opens.
Consequence: If the export passes without an assigned SSD, the clinic remains scheduled but the missing catalog cannot be supplied through club equipment.

parameter.title: Sonoran Nightwatchers plate-solving clinic
parameter.description: Hands-on practice using imaging laptops and sample sky frames for offline plate-solving workflows.
parameter.location: Agua Caliente Park ranch house classroom, Tucson, AZ

parameter.subject: June 3 plate-solving clinic catalog check
parameter.body: We are testing whether the June 3 clinic must use the offline DesertSky plate-solving catalog because the classroom Wi-Fi has been unreliable. Please do not send equipment requests yet; loaner catalog SSD availability and the claim channel will be announced after the bench test.

parameter.subject: Offline catalog required for the plate-solving clinic
parameter.body: The bench test is complete: every active laptop station for June 3 must have the DesertSky offline catalog available before arrival. Participants can either use a local catalog install verified by May 28 at 17:00 or have a club catalog SSD assigned on the exported equipment list. Please wait for Sol's hold thread before requesting an SSD.

parameter.content: Clinic loaner update: the hold thread for DesertSky catalog SSDs is now open. Three SSDs remain for June 3 plate-solving stations; entries need the clinic date and connector type. I will close the thread May 28 at 16:00 and send the assignment list to Avery at 17:00.

parameter.subject: Plate-solving clinic equipment list exported
parameter.body: The June 3 equipment list was exported at 17:00. Club catalog SSD assignments are now locked, and no additional media can be added at check-in. Anyone not assigned an SSD must already have the DesertSky catalog installed and verified on their clinic laptop.
